title: Hiring illustrators for trading card project
content:

author: Kat
title: Paid human illustrator for short-story series
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.

What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Maybe a little less intricate, but I want that “I’ve seen flashes of this in my dreams” creepy feeling? Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration, because I don’t know but I want to do this the right way. If you’re an artist who likes to read, even better. 12 stories planned. Artist would get credit. Contact: DM on Threads.
